festivalInfo.name: Tanzania Biashara Festival
festivalInfo.motto: Every business has a place, every city has an opportunity.
festivalInfo.mottoSw: Kila biashara ina nafasi yake, kila mji una fursa yake.
festivalInfo.vision: To be Tanzania's premier platform for business, innovation, and investment opportunities.
festivalInfo.visionSw: Kuwa jukwaa kuu na bora zaidi nchini Tanzania kwa fursa za biashara, ubunifu, na uwekezaji.
festivalInfo.mission: To create an inclusive platform that connects people, businesses, and investors through opportunities that drive sustainable economic growth.
festivalInfo.missionSw: Kutengeneza jukwaa jumuishi linalounganisha watu, biashara, na wawekezaji kupitia fursa zinazochochea ukuaji endelevu wa uchumi.
